notes: A round two-drum pavilion on the OSM footprint, flagged curved: its nine surveyed vertices lie within 2.6 % of one radius about the area centroid, so the ground-storey drum is the round wall they describe (through every vertex, each edge an arc of the fitted 9.10 m circle; scripts/blender-buildings/curved-footprint.mjs), shaded smooth, warm cream stucco standing straight on the ground. A ribbon of dark-red framed windows on its north (bridge) half, a broad thick dark-red flat eave ring, and a smaller set-back upper drum with round windows under its own dark-red eave. No measured height: the shell top is the runtime fallback height (2 levels x 3.2 m). The ground round it is left to the street passes: the footprint record carries no surface, and the extract holds the concrete footways beside it as ways, not a paved area. Look values from the round-0 street reference, in words only.
